summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 16.04 xenial, i386), built a local apt repository at /srv/localrepo from downloaded .deb files (target package cowsay + cowsay-off), served it via python3 http.server on $NODE_IP:8080, blocked the remote Ubuntu mirrors via /etc/hosts and pointed apt sources solely at the local repo, then successfully installed cowsay entirely from local storage while remote repos returned connection-refused. Restored normal apt/hosts config afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted via shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified recovered state (cowsay still installed and functional, local repo files intact, apt sources back to remote config, remote mirror reachable again).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/repo baseline (Ubuntu 16.04 xenial, remote sources, esm-infra source)
Confirmed remote mirror reachable at baseline and target package cowsay not installed
Installed dpkg-dev, downloaded cowsay+deps into /srv/localrepo, generated Packages/Packages.gz via dpkg-scanpackages
Started detached python3 http.server on port 8080 to serve the local repo
Blocked remote Ubuntu mirrors via /etc/hosts, switched apt sources to local-only, ran apt-get update and apt-get install -y cowsay successfully from local repo
Captured explicit proof remote mirror was unreachable (connection refused) and apt history confirming local install
Restored /etc/hosts and apt sources.list to original remote configuration, confirmed remote reachable again and cowsay still installed
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and service health
Restarted node1 via sudo shutdown -r now with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH available again
Verified boot_id changed and boot time updated, confirming genuine restart
Verified post-restart recovery: cowsay still installed and functional, local repo files intact, apt sources restored, remote mirror reachable

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: Downloaded cowsay .deb into /srv/localrepo, generated Packages.gz with dpkg-scanpackages, and served it via python3 http.server on port 8080 (curl to Packages.gz returned HTTP 200).

evidence.requirement: Package installed from local repo while remote repos unreachable
evidence.summary: With /etc/hosts redirecting archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com to 127.0.0.1 and apt sources pointed only at the local repo, apt-get update/install succeeded and installed cowsay (dpkg -l confirms 'ii cowsay'); a direct curl to archive.ubuntu.com during this window returned 'Connection refused', and apt history.log shows 'Install: cowsay'.

evidence.requirement: Restore original configuration after demonstrating local repo install
evidence.summary: Restored /etc/hosts and /etc/apt/sources.list from backups; confirmed remote mirror reachable again (HTTP 200) and cowsay remained installed.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (2f708738-...), boot time (Jun 14 21:27), local repo server listening on 8080, and cowsay installed, as pre-restart baseline.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued 'sudo shutdown -r now' backgrounded via nohup; command returned 'reboot_acknowledged' immediately before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: SSH was refused immediately after the reboot command (node down), then after polling, SSH succeeded again with a new boot_id (0c5473bf-...) and new boot time (Sep 29 09:11), differing from the pre-restart baseline.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: After restart, cowsay package remained installed and functional (cowsay command output verified), local repo files persisted on disk, and apt sources/remote reachability were confirmed back to normal.
